summary: Allow authorized seat restart after mailbox channel loss

replay.detail: Restart does not replay messages, inputs, tools or approvals, or acknowledge recovery of the old channel.

schema.detail: No database table, index, migration or schema version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or sealing changes.

compatibility.detail: The CLI waits through predecessor-incarnation faults after an accepted restart and reports only replacement faults or restart failure events referencing its exact request. Restart API and authority remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No automatic restart or additional deploy interruption; an explicitly requested restart retains its existing stop and launch behavior.

manual.detail: Existing authorized agents restart commands continue to work without a new force flag or permission.

recovery.detail: No store recovery or rollback change; explicit restart fences the predecessor and does not clear its mailbox-loss fault as recovered.
